name: sUSD
oneLiner: Synthetix sUSD is an overcollateralized debt-pool stablecoin backed by SNX, ETH, and USDC; SNX minting was deprecated in 2025 and sUSD has traded below peg.
collateral: SNX, ETH, and USDC/stataUSDC via Synthetix V3; direct SNX minting deprecated in 2025; sUSD now backed primarily by delta-neutral basis-trade vaults and protocol treasury activity
pegMechanism: Overcollateralization via C-ratio (200%+); V3 expanded collateral to SNX, ETH, USDC/stataUSDC; sUSD minting against SNX deprecated in 2025; peg sustained via SLP Vault basis-trade strategy and protocol fee buybacks

oracleRisk.summary: Synthetix sUSD historically relies on Chainlink-decentralized price feeds for synth pricing, with no stronger failover tier verified here.

notices.title: Prolonged depeg
notices.message: sUSD has traded materially below its $1 target since the SIP-420 C-ratio reduction. Use live runtime data for the current price; peg restoration is targeted for mid-2026 via the V3 transition and SLP vault strategy.
